facts.fact: The Leveraged Years says article 6 of CSCA decision 50-26, deliberated on 16 June 2026, bars licensed radio and television from broadcasting AI-generated or AI-transformed election content liable to mislead the public or harm the integrity of the electoral debate, with a narrow labelled exception, for the election period from 15 August 2026.

The Leveraged Years says HACA, the broadcast regulator acting under laws 15-11 and 77.03, regulates licensees under decision 50-26 on AI election content; it does not say who enforces it beyond HACA's supervisory powers.
